methods.label: Correcting double counting
methods.explanation: The number of elements in the union equals the sum of the numbers of elements in the two sets minus the common elements counted twice: \(3+3−2=4\).
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary counting of a two-set union, explicitly covered by the catalog's union node.
